extracted.name: Savoy Cabbage and Mushrooms
extracted.description: I often make this simple recipe for savoy cabbage and mushrooms in the fall, either as a side dish or as part of a vegetarian meal.
instruction_lines: Heat oil in a pot over medium-low heat. Add cabbage and mushrooms; cook and stir until softened, about 5 minutes. Season with cilantro and salt. Add broth, cover, and simmer until cabbage is cooked through, about 20 minutes.
